title: Mt.FUJI 100 — REGARDING RACE ENTRIES (2027)
claims: Entrants must be male or female, at least 18 years old on race day, and able to complete the course within the time limit without getting lost.

For the FUJI100mi, entrants must have finished either one ITRA-certified race worth 4 points or more, or two races worth 3 points or more, between two years before the general entry opening date and the day before it, and must be able to prove this on the ITRA results page.
Virtual FUJI100mi 2026, Virtual KAI70k 2026 and Virtual ASUMI40k 2026 do not count as qualifying races.
Priority entry for the 2027 FUJI100mi is open from 19 October 2026 at 12:00 to 15 November 2026 at 23:59 to runners ranked in the top 100 overall of Mt.FUJI100 2026 and to elite athletes.

General and donation entry for the 2027 FUJI100mi run from 2 November 2026 at 12:00 to 15 November 2026 at 23:59, with the lottery result announced on 1 December 2026 and payment from 1 to 15 December 2026.
The 2027 FUJI100mi entry fee is 50,000 yen including tax; the donation entry is 105,000 yen including a 55,000 yen donation and the 50,000 yen entry fee; the private supporter entry is 5,500 yen.

Elite invitation standards for the FUJI100mi are an ITRA Performance Index of 850 or above for men and 715 or above for women for the free invitation, and 800 or above for men and 650 or above for women for the paid invitation, based on 100k or 100M races.

Participation conditions require entrants to understand the distance and the special nature of running through mountainous terrain for more than a day and night, to have trained for it, and to deal independently with expected trouble, bad weather, extreme fatigue, digestive problems, muscle pain and minor injuries.
The conditions state that the organisers are not responsible for those issues, and that a violation of the participation conditions in the 2027 race may lead to refusal of entry from 2028 onwards.

After payment, no change of event or cancellation is accepted for any reason and entry fees are not refunded; the right to participate cannot be transferred to a third party; a photo ID is required when exchanging the number card.
Parking is by reservation only, parking tickets are sold in advance, and there is no parking available for athletes at the finish venue, Kitafuji Park.

The English entry page states the priority entry period as 'November 19, 2026 (Monday)' and the general entry as 'November 2, 2026 (Monday)', while the Japanese page gives 19 October and 2 November 2026; the Japanese page is internally consistent with the 15 November closing date.
Donation entry is first-come (senchaku-sei) rather than a lottery; the lottery applies only to general entry when the capacity is exceeded.
FUJI100mi capacities for 2027 are 1,900 general entries (domestic and overseas), 100 donation entries and 500 private supporters.
Private supporter entry for the 2027 FUJI100mi runs from 5 January 2027 at 12:00 to 12 January 2027 at 23:59, with the lottery result on 18 January 2027 and payment from 18 to 24 January 2027.
